bloques.titulo: It may indicate that something has been completed or that something regrettable / unwanted has occurred.
texto: El contexto define el matiz: 宿題をしてしまった puede ser «terminé los deberes»; 財布をなくしてしまった expresa pesar. In informal speaking, there is a provision for the provision of information.
I've lost my wallet, what a rage.
